Decision to make

You support a personal task workspace. Compare baseline and assisted time including review.

Core concept

Compare comparable tasks and include setup and checking time. Track quality with speed so faster errors do not look like improvement.

Practice contract

Compare 8 baseline minutes per record with 2 assisted minutes plus 7 review minutes for missing/low confidence, or 1 minute otherwise.

Evidence and boundary

Show normal, missing and uncertain cases. No real data or external actions.

Review and reflect

Baseline minus assisted time including review
